quests.name: Meadow Cull
quests.offer: The leaf wisps choke the meadow paths. Thin them out — eight should do.
quests.turnIn: The paths breathe easier already. You may be the one the castle is waiting for.

quests.name: An Audience
quests.offer: Take the east road to Castle Aldermere. King Aldric should hear of your deeds from your own mouth.
quests.turnIn: So Bran's letters were not exaggeration. Good. Aldermere has work for you.

quests.name: The King's Writ
quests.offer: Carry my writ across the north sea to Thane Bruni of Gearford. Buy passage at the port — or sail your own.
quests.turnIn: A royal writ! Ha! Then Gearford stands with the crown. And you, courier, stand taller than you look.

quests.name: The Sunken Seal
quests.offer: The old crypt in Sylvas' swamp cracked open. Wights walk. Break three of them and the seal can be re-cut.
quests.turnIn: Three wights unmade. The seal will hold — for now. The elves owe you a song.

quests.name: The Spire Key
quests.offer: The storm over Miradel is no weather. Scout the Storm Spire's inner court and come back breathing.
quests.turnIn: Inside the walls and out again — that's the measure I hoped for. The King must hear of this.

quests.name: The Warden of Storms
quests.offer: End it. Slay the Storm Warden atop the Spire, and the crown's own airship — the Brasswing — is yours.
quests.turnIn: The storm breaks. Aldermere breathes. Take the Brasswing, hero — the sky was always yours.

quests.name: The Bramble Pack
quests.offer: Bramble wolves have taken the east woods. Six pelts' worth of culling, if you can.
quests.turnIn: Fewer howls tonight. Brasshollow thanks you.

quests.name: Heart of the Mine
quests.offer: Something old woke in the Hollow Mine — a Magitek Warden from the war. End it.
quests.turnIn: So the war's last sentry finally rests. Keep its core; you earned it.

quests.name: Road Patrol
quests.offer: My recruits can't hold the east road. Put down six wolves and I'll see you paid from the castle purse.
quests.turnIn: Road's quiet. You'd make a fine guard — worse pay than adventuring, mind.

quests.name: Brute Iron
quests.offer: Hill brutes smash our ore sledges flat. Break four of them and Gearford's old war tank is yours — we kept it oiled.
quests.turnIn: Four brutes down! The tank's yours. Treads eat hills and forest alike — mind the fuel gauge. Joking. It runs on spite.

quests.name: The Marsh Lights
quests.offer: The lights in the swamp are hungry things wearing lantern-shapes. Snuff six of them.
quests.turnIn: Six lights out. The road home is honest again. Take this rod — it remembers older storms.

quests.name: Scorpion Season
quests.offer: Every caravan this month lost a wheel — or a driver — to dune scorpions. Six fewer would make my week.
quests.turnIn: Six! Oh, splendid. Dinner's on me forever, dear — and take this for the road.

quests.name: Lamplight Bounty
quests.offer: Miners pay the Tankard to post this: five cave bats dead, coin on delivery. Rumor's free, ale isn't.
quests.turnIn: Five bats! The miners' guild drinks here tonight — and your coin's in the till.

quests.name: A Quiet Delivery
quests.offer: Three chunks of ore. Unmarked. Leave them with me and forget my face.
quests.turnIn: …Good. The coin is real. The rest never happened.

quests.name: Pelts, No Questions
quests.offer: Two wolf pelts. Clean ones. My buyer is particular and imaginary.
quests.turnIn: Lovely. You never saw me, and these were always mine.

quests.name: The Party's Contract
quests.offer: We took a contract on Kharzum brutes, but Brand's shoulder is out. Two kills and we split your share fair.
quests.turnIn: Two brutes, clean work. Here's your cut — drink's on Kit.

quests.name: A Warm Meal
quests.offer: Three berries and I feast like a king. A small king. A berry king.
quests.turnIn: A feast! You're kinder than the cobbles, friend. Take an old road-blessing with you.

quests.name: Wolves at the Fold
quests.offer: Five wolves out of my pastures, or there'll be no wool worth shearing come spring.
quests.turnIn: The flock sleeps sound tonight. So will I, first time in weeks.

quests.name: Fence Mending
quests.offer: Storm took forty feet of fence. Five good wood and I can mend it before the goats notice.
quests.turnIn: Straight rails again. You've the arms of a farmhand, whatever they pay you.

quests.name: Oasis Baskets
quests.offer: The caravan wants six baskets of berries and my pickers want naps. Help an honest farmer?
quests.turnIn: Six baskets, sweet and sound. The caravan pays me, I pay you — desert economics.

quests.name: An Edge of Fang
quests.offer: Dire fangs hold an edge steel envies. Four, and I'll owe you.
quests.turnIn: Fine teeth. Come back when you've the stomach for real steel.

quests.name: Steel for the Smith
quests.offer: Two steel bars — smelt them yourself at the forge and I'll finish something special.
quests.turnIn: Good bars. Take the blade — first of its batch.

quests.name: Pie Day at the Tankard
quests.offer: Pie day tomorrow and my oven's cold. Two berry pies saves the Tankard's honor.
quests.turnIn: The Tankard's honor is saved. Wedge for the road?

quests.name: A Collector's Interest
quests.offer: Ancient coins surface in crypts and camps. Three, for more gil than they're worth.
quests.turnIn: Marvelous. Provenance dubious, patina exquisite.

quests.name: The Dire Kind
quests.offer: Dire wolves by the old watchtower. Four fewer and solo work gets safer for us all.
quests.turnIn: Four dire wolves alone? Maybe you ARE the solo kind.

quests.name: The Foreman Falls
quests.offer: Miners whisper of a Foreman deeper than the Warden's chamber. End the whispering.
quests.turnIn: The mine breathes easy at last. Brasshollow owes you twice over.

quests.name: The Old Watchtower
quests.offer: The ruined watchtower north of the farms — scout what's denned in it.
quests.turnIn: Dire wolves in the kingsworks. Of course. Stand by.

quests.name: Retake the Watchtower
quests.offer: Clear the den. Three dire wolves and the masons can move in.
quests.turnIn: The crown rebuilds. You made the ground safe for it.

quests.name: The Golden Rumor
quests.offer: A slime of solid gold in Miradel's deep desert. Bring proof it dies like anything else.
quests.turnIn: So even greed has a body. The treasury thanks you — take its heart.

quests.name: Cold as Kharzum
quests.offer: Five ice shards keep my cellar cold through the thaw. The ale thanks you in advance.
quests.turnIn: Cellar's cold, ale's perfect. First pour's yours.

quests.name: The Cellar-Wreckers
quests.offer: Frost golems cracked the cellar wall — twice. Break two of THEM and we're square.
quests.turnIn: Wall's holding. Winter's just weather again.

quests.name: Timber for Handles
quests.offer: Eight good wood. Dwarven steel deserves better handles than dwarven driftwood.
quests.turnIn: Straight grain! You've an eye. Tools all round.

quests.name: Lights Out
quests.offer: Gloom wisps drift closer each dusk. Six snuffed buys the glade a quiet week.
quests.turnIn: Quiet dusk tonight. Moss-mead's on the house.

quests.name: What Stalks the Mist
quests.offer: Something big walks behind the wisps. Four stalkers down and I'll believe the mist is just mist.
quests.turnIn: Just mist now. Take this cloak — a ranger left it and won't be back.

quests.name: The Dose Makes the Cure
quests.offer: Three venom sacs, intact. In small doses they cure what they cause.
quests.turnIn: Perfect extraction. Medicine is just danger, diluted.

quests.name: The Beet Menace
quests.offer: Bog slimes found my beet rows. FIVE of them. My beets. Avenge us.
quests.turnIn: The rows are safe. The beets… will remember.

quests.name: The Crown Below
quests.offer: The wights bow to something crowned. The seal will never hold while it reigns.
quests.turnIn: The crown below is dust. Sylvas sleeps whole tonight.

quests.name: The Singing Stones
quests.offer: Old stones sing in Kharzum's snow. Stand in their circle and listen for me.
quests.turnIn: They still sing the old key. Good. And something guards them, you say…

quests.name: The Obsidian Warden
quests.offer: The guardian of the stones has forgotten friend from foe. Put it to rest.
quests.turnIn: The stones sing alone now. It is kinder that way.

quests.name: Jackals at the Cistern
quests.offer: Jackals dug into the cistern line. Six gone and Willowick drinks easy.
quests.turnIn: The cistern runs clear. So does the fizz-wine — have one.

quests.name: Cores for the Contraption
quests.offer: Two storm cores and the contraption WILL work this time. Probably. Bring a bucket.
quests.turnIn: IT LIVES! Briefly. Here — hazard pay.

quests.name: Too Much Sun
quests.offer: Sun wisps scorch the caravan road by noon. Four fewer, please, before someone cooks.
quests.turnIn: The road's walkable at noon again. Oasis-blessed, you are.

quests.name: Smoke in the Pines
quests.offer: Smoke north of the glade that isn't ours. Find the camp; don't be seen. Or be seen loudly, your call.
quests.turnIn: A fortified camp with a chief. That's a contract, then.

quests.name: The Chief's Price
quests.offer: The Bandit Chief has a price on his head longer than my sword. Split it with us.
quests.turnIn: Contract closed. Drinks, then the next road.

quests.name: Wren's Saplings
quests.offer: Six wood for a windbreak and my saplings might see spring.
quests.turnIn: The wind can howl all it likes now. Thank you kindly.
